jobs.title: IT Software Engineer, Infrastructure
jobs.description: <p data-pm-slice="1 1 []">GAQ327R265</p> <p><strong>About the Role</strong></p> <p>At Databricks Information Technology, we are a product-led organisation transforming the way we work, from how easy it is to use our IT services to the applications we develop to help us scale seamlessly amid incredible growth.</p> <p>As an <strong>IT Software Engineer (Infrastructure)</strong>, you will be a core technical contributor on the IT CorpEng Infrastructure team, owning and driving the evolution of our core infrastructure and observability platforms. This role requires a strong software engineering mindset, deep technical breadth across SRE and infrastructure worlds, and the ability to deliver high-quality, scalable solutions for currently "immature" system problems. You will be responsible for building resilient, scalable, and automated infrastructure that empowers our development teams. As a member of the team, you will bridge the gap between software engineering and systems architecture, ensuring our AWS environment is cost-optimised, secure, and highly available.</p> <p data-renderer-start-pos="1648"><strong data-renderer-mark="true">The impact you will have:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Automate:</strong> Develop and deploy production-grade infrastructure on cloud platforms (AWS preferred) using Infrastructure as Code tools like Terraform or Pulumi.</li> <li><strong>Orchestration:</strong> Deploy, manage, and scale containerised workloads using Kubernetes (EKS/AKS), focusing on security, reliability, and resource efficiency.</li> <li><strong>CI/CD Excellence:</strong> Build and maintain robust deployment pipelines using GitHub Actions, including both cloud-hosted and self-hosted runners for specialised build requirements.</li> <li><strong>Drive "Observable by Default" Frameworks:</strong> Implement infrastructure standards to ensure new internal applications are secure, with logging, metrics, and tracing configured out of the box.</li> <li><strong>Tooling, Scripting &amp; AI:</strong> Build internal CLI tools, AI-assisted workflows, and automation scripts to streamline developer workflows and reduce manual toil.</li> <li><strong>Partner Cross-Functionally:</strong> Collaborate with Security, Engineering, Infrastructure, and Support teams to execute technical projects aligned with business outcomes.</li> <li><strong>Document &amp; Knowledge Share:</strong> Participate in peer code reviews, maintain operational playbooks/failure triage guides, and help onboard team members onto platforms you maintain.</li> </ul> <p data-renderer-start-pos="2367"><strong data-renderer-mark="true">What we look
